name: mtg-tournament-analysis
description: Analyze Magic: The Gathering tournament results from melee.gg, MTGO, MTGGoldfish, and magic.gg. Surfaces meta trends, matchup data, and what changed week over week. Local-first: a guided setup script and local scrapers do the data collection, and setup seeds a per-format archetype baseline from mtgtop8 so a fresh install has a starting point.
